validate_loopback_redirect_uri: validate an OAuth redirect URI to ensure it points to a loopback address like localhost or 127.0.0.1
review_validate_loopback_redirect_uri: review the validate_loopback_redirect_uri function to verify it rejects non-loopback hosts and URIs with fragments
refactor_validate_loopback_redirect_uri: refactor validate_loopback_redirect_uri to also accept a custom list of allowed hostnames beyond loopback
test_validate_loopback_redirect_uri: test validate_loopback_redirect_uri with IPv6 loopback address 0:0:0:0:0:0:0:1 and expect it to pass validation
summarize_token_no_cache_headers: summarize the TOKEN_NO_CACHE_HEADERS constant that sets no-store and no-cache headers for OAuth token responses
